# customer-journey-base-subscription-mockup.png

**Type:** UI wireframe/mockup, screen 6 of the customer journey flow.
**Source context:** `## Customer Journey screen flow`, step 6, the root
SASE offering configuration (number of Actors, price plan, contract
term).

Left nav tree: `Configuration` > `SASE` > `Base Subscription`
(selected), `Locations`, `Add-ons Subscription`. Right panel
"Number of Actors" field set to `35`, with three plan radio options
(`Silver Plan` €12/actor/month from 0-20, `Gold Plan` €11/actor/month
from 21-40 — selected, matching the 35 Actors entered, `Platinum Plan`
€10/actor/month from 41+), and `Contract Term` set to `2` years ("10%
off for two years, 17% off for three years"), with `OK`
(highlighted/clicked) and `Cancel` buttons.
